keywords: The Plaintiff instituted an action in the District Court of Embilipitiya seeking a declaration of title and to prevent the Defendants from entering his land held under a Mahaweli Development Authority permit. Held — the Defendants had not constructed a new road but merely repaired an existing road long used by villagers; the District Court\'s findings were consistent with the evidence and not tainted with illegalities; appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
